why: The only save test posts an admin crash with no gym or install id (crash.test.mjs:52-63); no test sends either. Low risk: the INSERT hard-codes gym and sender as '' (crash.js:143).

HQ reads watch logs only through scripts/feedback.py:55-59 (screen='watch-diary'); no test covers that view, and test_feedback_inbox.py has no watch/diary case. Phone-side tests stop at the sent body (watchDiag.test.ts:266-290).

No wear test touches the asked/answered prefs (grep of wear/src/test finds none); only ScreenSelector priority is pinned (WatchLayoutTest.kt:17-21). The code itself does record each answer (MainActivity.kt:146,158,768-771), so this is a test gap, not a live fault.

No test runs a second deploy against sw.js keepShell/old-file drop (sw.js:34-53); offline e2e (offline.spec.mjs:34, offline3.spec.mjs) only covers one version, webPush.test.ts only the push handlers, and the SKIP test list omits /checkin (legalPages.test.ts:130). The regex itself does skip checkin (sw.js:17).

The only on-screen alerts test turns alerts on/off for the owner with a working key (alerts-uat.spec.mjs:308-369); the desk part only reads the words, never presses the switch (:371-387); NOT_SET_UP is tested only at the Worker (webKey.test.mjs:27-37) and a refused browser only in a unit check (webPush.test.ts:73), not on a screen.

todaySuggestions counts 'ending'/'dues' straight from the member lists and never reads d.sent (suggestions.ts:125-147), though useAssistantData loads the sent list (useAssistantData.ts:33-40); the only use of sent is a per-day cap/calm nudge on the message card (plan.ts:584-588), not a same-group check. S3 fits: owner sees the group and the cap limits repeats.

App pop-ups find the member only by roster phone = app checkin_phone plus first name (0073_member_push_more.sql:50-62, the only definition of _roster_app_members); the form hint mentions only finding and WhatsApp (MemberFormSheet.tsx:327) and the edit save has no app check (:155-157).

Seeing news on Today only calls markInfoShown, which writes localStorage (alertFacts.ts:182-200, NeedsYou.tsx:619-621); the bell count and summary push read the server gym_alert_reads (alertInbox.ts:88-93, 0098:147-154), so they still count it. No later migration changes _alert_pending_for.

Who-was-done is kept only in browser storage per message list (sendQueue.ts:9-14, readDone :118-125); Renewals due (OwnerNumbers.tsx:550-559, openWhatsApp :664-667) never imports sendQueue, and no server record of a WhatsApp tap exists in the panel code.

Each save with new content gets a new content hash, so the tag '<kind>:<ref>:<hash>:<member>' is new and a fresh note is written (0073:155-166, 0073:97-99); the sender sends every undone note with no per-plan cooldown (0054:194-218); the edit screen only says members see the plan (DietPlans.tsx:50,447).

friendReward returns 'ready' unless the enquiry's own rewardGiven is set (referrals.ts:118-135); the only other guard, alreadyRewarded, matches the exact friend-reward note wording (:108-111), so days added by hand from the member page are never seen and 'Give free days' stays (Enquiries.tsx:562-567).

The Message link is a bare wa.me anchor with no onClick or save (Today.tsx:652-670), and the list is filtered only by needsAttentionToday on plan state (Today.tsx:115-118), so a messaged member stays with no mark.

The tab title counts needsItems (plan requests, phone links, shop orders, questions, member messages: needsYou.ts:51-59, NeedsYou.tsx:462-465), while the bell adds the server inbox count plus app news and HQ unread (WhatsNew.tsx:416-417); they are different lists, so enquiries and online joins never show on the tab.

Both switches set 'blocked' only from notificationsGranted(), the app-wide permission (GymSettings.tsx:96-99,134-137; workoutAlerts.ts:158-166); the gym channel's own state is read only for the feedback device line (noticeAlertsRun.ts:221-228), so a single turned-off channel shows no warning.

gymRemindersOn lives only in the phone's prefs store (phonePrefs.ts:34-39,155-156) and is read only by the local scheduler, which just cancels (gymReminders.ts:259); no code sends it to the server, so the owner cannot see it.
